remain intact: Even after the strong earthquake, the old temple in our town remained intact, which surprised many engineers.
即使經歷了強烈地震，我們鎮上的老廟仍保持完好，讓許多工程師感到驚訝。
keep one's dignity intact: Although he lost the election, he kept his dignity intact by thanking his supporters and congratulating the winner.
雖然他落選了，但他向支持者道謝並恭喜當選人，保全了自己的尊嚴。
survive intact: Wrapped carefully in bubble wrap, my grandmother's glass vase survived intact during the long move to Taipei.
用氣泡紙仔細包好後，奶奶的玻璃花瓶在搬到台北的漫長過程中安然無損地留存下來。
be left intact: The fire destroyed the kitchen, but the bedrooms upstairs were left intact, so the family could still sleep there.
大火燒毀了廚房，但樓上的臥室完好無損，所以這家人仍能睡在那裡。
intellectual property: Downloading movies illegally means stealing the intellectual property of the artists and companies who created them.
非法下載電影就等於竊取創作這些電影的藝術家和公司的智慧財產權。
an intellectual challenge: For many students, solving a difficult math puzzle is an intellectual challenge that they enjoy as much as a game.
對許多學生來說，解一道困難的數學謎題是一種智力上的挑戰，他們享受它就像享受遊戲一樣。
intellectual curiosity: Her intellectual curiosity led her to read books about history, science, and art even during summer vacation.
她的求知慾使她即使在暑假期間也閱讀歷史、科學和藝術方面的書。
an intellectual: My uncle is an intellectual who spends his weekends reading philosophy and writing articles for newspapers.
我叔叔是一位知識分子，週末都在閱讀哲學並替報紙撰寫文章。
intelligent life: Scientists have been searching the universe for years, hoping to find signs of intelligent life on other planets.
科學家多年來一直在搜尋宇宙，希望在其他星球上找到智慧生命的跡象。
an intelligent guess: I didn't know the answer, but based on the clues in the passage, I made an intelligent guess and got it right.
我不知道答案，但根據文章中的線索，我做了一個有根據的猜測，結果猜對了。
an intelligent question: The speaker was impressed when a student asked an intelligent question that showed she had thought deeply about the topic.
一位學生提出了一個有見地的問題，顯示她對這個主題深入思考過，讓講者印象深刻。
intense pressure: Many senior high school students feel intense pressure before the college entrance exam because their parents expect high scores.
許多高中生在大學入學考試前感受到巨大的壓力，因為父母期望他們考高分。
intense heat: The intense heat of the summer afternoon made it impossible for us to play basketball outside.
夏日午後的酷熱讓我們根本無法在外面打籃球。
intense competition: Only five students will get the scholarship, and with intense competition from over three hundred applicants, few expect to win.
只有五名學生能獲得獎學金，面對三百多名申請者的激烈競爭，很少人期待自己會獲選。
an intense person: Jack is such an intense person that he studies twelve hours a day and never stops until everything is perfect.
傑克是個情感強烈的人，他一天讀書十二小時，不到一切完美絕不罷休。
intense pain: After falling off his bike, Tom felt intense pain in his ankle and could not walk at all.
從腳踏車上摔下來後，湯姆的腳踝感到劇痛，完全無法走路。
an intensive course: Before studying in Canada, I took an intensive course in English that met for six hours every day for a month.
去加拿大留學前，我上了一個英文密集課程，連續一個月每天上六小時。
intensive care unit (ICU): After the car accident, the driver was taken to the intensive care unit (ICU) because his injuries were very serious.
車禍後，駕駛因傷勢非常嚴重而被送進加護病房。
intensive farming: Intensive farming produces large amounts of food, but heavy use of chemicals can harm the soil and rivers.
密集農業能生產大量糧食，但大量使用化學物質會傷害土壤和河川。
labor-intensive: Picking tea leaves by hand is a labor-intensive job, so farmers often need to hire many workers during the harvest.
手工採茶是勞力密集的工作，所以茶農在收成期常需要雇用許多工人。
capital-intensive: Building a factory that makes computer chips is capital-intensive, requiring billions of dollars in machines and equipment.
興建一座生產電腦晶片的工廠是資本密集的，需要數十億元的機器和設備。
be intent on winning: Her eyes fixed on the finish line, the runner was intent on winning and ignored the pain in her legs.
那位跑者雙眼緊盯終點線，一心想贏，完全不理會雙腿的疼痛。
an intent gaze: The cat watched the bird outside the window with an intent gaze, not moving at all for several minutes.
貓用專注的凝視看著窗外的鳥，好幾分鐘都一動也不動。
with intent to kill: The man was charged with attacking his neighbor with intent to kill after police found a knife in his car.
警方在他車上找到一把刀後，這名男子被控意圖殺人攻擊鄰居。
to all intents and purposes: The project isn't officially finished, but to all intents and purposes it is done; we only need to print the report.
這個專案還沒正式完成，但實際上已經做好了；我們只需要把報告印出來。
interior design: My sister studies interior design and helped us choose the furniture, colors, and lights for our new apartment.
我姊姊主修室內設計，她幫我們為新公寓挑選家具、顏色和燈具。
the interior of the country: Few people live in the interior of the country because it is far from the coast and covered with mountains.
很少人住在這個國家的內陸地區，因為那裡離海岸很遠而且滿是高山。
the Minister of the Interior: The Minister of the Interior announced new rules to improve public safety and traffic control during the holiday season.
內政部長宣布了新規定，以在假期期間改善公共安全與交通管制。
an interior monologue: In the novel, the writer uses an interior monologue to show the hero's private thoughts and fears before the battle.
在這本小說中，作者用內心獨白來呈現主角在戰鬥前的私密想法與恐懼。
